name: esp-zw-app-scanner
description: Antigravity side panel and subnet scanner for ESPZWApplianceT2 microcontroller appliances: discover mixed firmware fleets, inspect firmware & hardware MACs, edit on-device locations or local nicknames, and trigger verified reboots.

Scan my local subnet for active ESPZWApplianceT2 devices
List my ZW appliances with their locations, hostnames, MACs, and firmware versions
